startup.speaker: Augustine
lines: Oho, a new-come challenger appears?
If it's a game of wits that you should seek,
Let's pray you're up to it, my dears.
I warn: my rhetoric is anything but meek.

startup.speaker: Augustine
lines: Though, if instead you're looking to be spoiled
On cards upcoming, from the land of Asphodel,
Your inclinations for such shall be foiled.
The shroud upon those, even I cannot dispel.

startup.speaker: Augustine
lines: But nonetheless, I know a man who went,
In search of some lost child who calms his pains.
A spoiler then, I'll give, for his descent:
The child is gone; naught but a Venous Core remains.

startup.speaker: Augustine
lines: So stick around, my dears, if you would like to play,
A game of guessing cards, with ✅ when right, and ❌ amiss,
A 🔶 for partly, or ⬆️ or ⬇️ to show the way.
But if it's previews that you seek, then head to Dis.

hint.speaker: Augustine
lines: Among the __EDCOUNT__ edition(s) that exist,
The art that's done by __ILLUST__ can't be missed.

hint.speaker: Augustine
lines: Perhaps you'll recognize this text that's on the card.
If so, then from here it won't be hard:
「__TEXT__」

hint.speaker: Augustine
lines: A __RARITY__ this card seems to be,
where it appears in __SET__, you see.

hint.speaker: Augustine
lines: Oh dears, you'll need to be a little braver,
And guess a card whose __EDCOUNT__ edition(s)
include this flavor:
「__FLAVOR__」

nohints.speaker: Augustine
lines: We've reached the end of this cascade.
I've nothing more to say to lend you aid.
